content_zh:
这三个时辰里，邀月一边往苏景的体内灌输功力，一边悉心的传授他移花接玉的内外功口诀！
极剧的痛楚之下，也真亏苏景能坚持下来，并把那些口诀都给记下来，大概就如同邀月所说，他真的是个武学奇才吧，当然，是被耽搁了的！
而当传功完成之后。
邀月早已经面色惨白，显然刚刚的传功就算是她，也损耗甚大！
而苏景这时才惊觉，果然不愧是移花宫宫主，到底阴险！
他震惊道：“宫主是说，方才的口诀是错的？！”
“不错！”
邀月自得道：“反正你也只要活过几日便可，我总得防备你将我移花宫明玉功口诀乱传出去吧？我告诉你的口诀，自然是错的，这一招移花接玉，若配合上我教你的口诀，你用的越多，体内便会承受越大的反震之力，若多用几次，恐怕非得浑身炸裂，内脏破碎而死不可，当然，十二星相若见到了你的移花接玉，恐怕早怕的魂飞幽冥了，绝不敢与你交手！”
苏景只能苦笑了，这家伙，还真是滴水不漏！果然不愧是移花宫宫主！
结果自己还是惹了一身腥，却没能捞到半点便宜！
“好了，快走吧！我迫不及待等着想看你的好戏了！”
邀月看了苏景一眼，说道：“留给你的时间，已经不多了！”
“是！只不过……”
“只不过什么？！”
邀月不耐烦道：“如今你已然身具我移花宫武学，还想怎样？”
苏景羞涩道：“是这样的宫主，我之前实在是人微位卑，不曾学过武学，纵然如今身怀移花宫之不世武学，但从未与人交过手，所以……”
他这是见缝插针，想要更多的好处了！
邀月哼道：“果然贪心，如今人都将死了，却还惦记着……也罢，以防万一，拿去吧！”
说着，丢给了苏景一把短小的剑刃！
苏景接过，拔出打量了一眼，该说邀月出品，必属精品么？

随手丢过来的，看来却也相当的不俗，一把黑绿色的短剑，剑长不过寻常兵刃的一半有余，乍一看不过墨绿，但若凝神望去，立时便会觉剑气森森，逼人眉睫，几乎连眼睛都难睁开……
他虽然不曾见过其他兵刃，却也知这定然是一把神兵！
震惊道：“这是……”
“这是我移花宫第一神兵，碧血照丹青，削铁如泥，你留作防身吧，反正日后你死了，我自会将此物收回！有此剑护体，纵然你未曾与人交手，十二星相这等人物，也万万不可能奈何得了你了！快去吧，我还等着看一场好戏呢！”
“多谢宫主！！！”
苏景大喜，这东西落自己手里，还不是肉包子打狗么？想拿回去？
想都别想……
当下生怕邀月后悔似的，急忙翻身上马，却笨拙的差点摔了下来，邀月耻笑道：“蠢货，连马也骑不好，江枫怎会派你去求援？”
而苏景险些摔倒，脚下不过本能一震，竟然轻飘飘的又飞了起来，正落到马上！
他震惊的看着自己的手……
邀月道：“我移花宫武学深奥玄妙，非你一个小小书童能够理解，能施展一二招，你死的也不冤了，去吧！”
她竟然真的把苏景当作死人了！
而苏景也不犹豫，直接驾马而去！
任务优先。
既然随机置换了江琴，也就意味着如果他的速度不够快，那么真的就请不来燕南天了！
到时候，恐怕江枫他们，真的会死在十二星相的手里！
而这对自己而言，是万万不能的……
毫无疑问，燕南天，是拯救江枫夫妻唯一的希望！
感受着体内那一股强大的异种真气，十二正经在刚刚三个时辰里，被尽数强行撕开，奇经八脉也开了两脉，不可思议的邀月，不可思议的明玉功，不过眨眼的功夫，楚南武道便已入门，直接渡过炼体，成为了炼气一级的高手，若是正常修炼的话，没有三四年的苦功，怕是不可能达到这样的地步！
虽然这是在牺牲了自己的筋脉的情况下……如果没有意外的话，恐怕这辈子，自己也止步于此了！

想着，苏景怒喝一声：“驾！！！”
狠狠一鞭甩在了马匹的屁股上，本来奔腾的速度更加的快了起来，而他动作虽然笨拙，但竟然也就挂在了上面，没有掉下来！
现在的话……终于可以想想，到底该怎么办了。
该怎么对付这个疯女人！
还有燕南天，如何让他听从自己的安排……

content_en:
During these three hours, Yaoyue was instilling Kung Fu into Su Jing's body while carefully teaching him the internal and external Kung Fu formula for transferring flowers and jade!
Under the extreme pain, it was a shame that Su Jing could persevere and write down all the formulas. Probably as Yao Yue said, he was really a martial arts wizard. Of course, he was delayed!
And when the transfer of power is completed.
Yao Yue's face had already turned pale. It was obvious that even she had suffered a lot from the power transfer just now!
But then Su Jing was shocked to realize that he was indeed the master of Yihua Palace, and how sinister he was!
He was shocked and said: "Palace Master is saying that the formula just now is wrong?!"
"Not bad!"
Yao Yue said proudly: "Anyway, you only need to live for a few days. I have to prevent you from spreading the secret of my Mingyu Move the Flower Palace secret, right? The formula I told you is naturally wrong. This move of moving flowers and jade, if it matches the formula I taught you, you can use it." The more you use, the greater the force of the shock will be in your body. If you use it a few more times, I am afraid that your whole body will explode, your internal organs will be broken, and you will die. Of course, the twelve stars will be scared to fly to the netherworld after seeing your transference, and they will never dare to fight with you!"
Su Jing could only smile bitterly, this guy is really impeccable! As expected, he is the master of Yihua Palace!
As a result, I still made a mess, but I couldn't get any advantage!
"Okay, let's go! I can't wait to see your show!"
Yaoyue glanced at Su Jing and said, "The time left for you is running out!"
"Yes! It's just..."
"Just what?!"
Yao Yue said impatiently: "Now that you have acquired my Yihua Palace martial arts, what else do you want?"
Su Jing said shyly: "Palace Master like this, I was really of a low status before and had never learned martial arts. Even though I now possess the unparalleled martial arts skills of Yihua Palace, I have never fought against anyone, so..."
He is taking advantage of every opportunity and wants more benefits!
Yao Yue hummed, "You are indeed greedy. Now everyone is about to die, but you are still thinking about it... Anyway, just in case, take it!"
With that said, he threw a short sword blade to Su Jing!
Su Jing took it, pulled it out and took a look at it. Should I say that it was produced by Yaoyue? It must be a high-quality product?
It was thrown over casually, but it looked quite impressive. It was a black-green dagger. The sword was only half the length of an ordinary weapon. It looked just dark green at first glance, but if you look at it carefully, you will immediately feel that the sword is so sinister and threatening that it is almost difficult to open your eyes...
Although he had never seen any other weapons, he knew that this must be a magic weapon!
Shocked: "This is..."
"This is the number one magic weapon of my Yihua Palace. It is green with blood and can be cut with iron like mud. You can keep it for self-defense. Anyway, if you die in the future, I will take it back! With this sword protecting your body, even if you have never fought with anyone, it is absolutely impossible for people like Twelve Stars to defeat you! Go quickly, I am still waiting to see a good show!"
"Thank you, Palace Master!!!"
Su Jing was overjoyed. If this thing fell into his hands, wouldn't it be like a meat bun beating a dog? Want to take it back?
Don't even think about it...
At that moment, as if she was afraid that Yao Yue would regret it, she hurriedly got on her horse, but was so clumsy that she almost fell off. Yao Yue laughed and said, "Idiot, you can't even ride a horse. How could Jiang Feng send you to ask for help?"
Su Jing almost fell down, but his feet shook instinctively, and he flew up again, landing on the horse!
He looked at his hands in shock...
Yao Yue said: "My Yihua Palace martial arts is so profound and mysterious that even a little book boy like you cannot understand it. If you can perform one or two moves, your death will not be unjust. Go ahead!"
She actually regarded Su Jing as a dead person!
And Su Jing didn't hesitate and rode away directly!
Tasks take priority.
Since Jiang Qin was randomly replaced, it means that if he is not fast enough, then Yan Nantian will really not be invited!
By then, I'm afraid Jiang Feng and the others will really die in the hands of the twelve zodiac signs.!
And this is absolutely impossible for me...
There is no doubt that Yan Nantian is the only hope to save Jiang Feng and his wife!
Feeling the powerful alien Qi in his body, all the twelve main meridians were forcibly torn apart in just three hours, and two of the eight extraordinary meridians were opened. The incredible Inviting the Moon, the incredible Mingyu Kung Fu, but in the blink of an eye, Chu Nan had already started martial arts, directly passed through the body training, and became a master of the first level of Qi refining. If he practiced normally, without three or four years of hard work, he would not have been able to reach this point!
Although this is at the expense of his own muscles and veins... If there is no accident, I am afraid that I will stop here in this life!
Thinking about it, Su Jing shouted angrily: "Drive!!!"
A whip was thrown hard on the horse's butt, and the galloping speed became even faster. Although his movements were clumsy, he actually hung on it and did not fall off!
Now... I can finally think about what to do.
How to deal with this crazy woman!
And Yan Nantian, how to make him obey his arrangements...
